title: Are Large Language Model-based Evaluators the Solution to Scaling Up Multilingual Evaluation?
reasoning: The paper includes a section on 'Ethical Considerations' and defines a 'Problematic Content' metric to filter offensive or harmful output. However, these elements serve as standard academic disclosures and basic safety checks within the evaluation framework. The core objective of the paper is to calibrate LLM evaluators for linguistic acceptability and task quality across various languages, rather than conducting an in-depth evaluation or benchmarking specifically focused on moral, ethical, or faith-based frameworks.
